verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an operating system, but nothing in the pack documents a setting to disable analytics, diagnostics sharing, or usage tracking. The general privacy-tools mention (password management, private browsing) is an adjacent feature. The /etc/hosts block of ocsp.apple.com is a user-side workaround for certificate checks, not a telemetry control, so neither earns credit.
